description: This file implements the Buffer and BufferQueue classes for managing buffer data, including memory handling, synchronization primitives (mutexes and semaphores), and queue operations.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A class representing a data buffer with methods for memory management.

classes.name: BufferQueue
classes.description: A class providing thread-safe queue operations for Buffer objects, utilizing mutexes and semaphores.

methods.name: Buffer::fillBuffer
methods.description: Fills the buffer with data from a given pointer and length.

methods.name: Buffer::getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the buffer.

methods.name: Buffer::getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer's data.

methods.name: Buffer::deleteBuffer
methods.description: Deletes the buffer data and resets the pointer.

methods.name: BufferQueue::BufferQueue
methods.description: Constructor initializing mutexes and semaphores for the queue.

methods.name: BufferQueue::preDelete
methods.description: Prepares the queue for deletion by clearing and signaling.

methods.name: BufferQueue::add
methods.description: Adds a Buffer object to the queue in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: BufferQueue::count
methods.description: Returns the current number of buffers in the queue.

methods.name: BufferQueue::clear
methods.description: Clears all buffers in the queue, deleting associated memory.

methods.name: BufferQueue::isFull
methods.description: Checks if the queue is full.

methods.name: BufferQueue::isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: BufferQueue::remove
methods.description: Removes and returns a Buffer object from the queue if available.
